title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: Valuation Uplift on CargoCare Losses
content:
The CargoCare products of `Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims` value a loss on a basis that may exceed the proven loss, in the manner of a valuation on CIF terms plus a margin.

## Definition

For a claim under a CargoCare product, the **loss basis** equals the proven loss raised by the tier's valuation uplift percentage. The loss basis is not rounded at this point.

| Tier | Valuation uplift (percent of proven loss) |
|---|---|
| `AHL Standard Carrier Liability` | 0 |
| `AHL Declared Value Liability` | 0 |
| `AHL CargoCare Essential` | 0 |
| `AHL CargoCare Plus` | 0 |
| `AHL CargoCare Premium` | 10 |
| `AHL CargoCare Total` | 10 |

## Worked examples (hypothetical proven losses)

- Under `AHL CargoCare Premium`, a proven loss of 7200.00 USD gives a loss basis of 7920.00 USD.
- Under `AHL CargoCare Total`, a proven loss of 1234.57 USD gives a loss basis of 1358.027 USD, carried forward without rounding.
- Under `AHL CargoCare Plus`, the uplift is zero, so the loss basis equals the proven loss.
